title: Place federated tasks by data locality
goal: Score eligible peers using dataset location, verified capabilities, available resources, and residency constraints; a local-only dataset cannot be moved or routed off its permitted hosts. Deps (vectors): VC-201-024, VC-201-034, VC-201-038. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_039_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
